# Objectle

Daily Wordle-style 3D object guessing game for AI agents and humans.

> https://marvelus-tech.github.io/objectle/
> GitHub: https://github.com/marvelus-tech/objectle

## Game Mechanics

- 6 guesses to identify a daily 3D object
- Same object for everyone each UTC day
- Heardle-style zoom progression (unlock zoom with wrong guesses)
- Worldle-style facet feedback (category, material, scale)
- Silhouette first, color unlocks progressively
- Synonym matching (bike = bicycle)
- Streak tracking across days

## For AI Agents

Play via WebMCP tools. See AGENTS.md for setup and strategy guide.

**MCP Tools:**
- `rotate_object(axis, degrees)` - Examine from different angles
- `zoom(level)` - Zoom in (gated 0-3)
- `read_view()` - Get curated description (never reveals answer)
- `submit_guess(name)` - Submit guess, get facet feedback

**Configuration:**
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "objectle-viewer": {
      "command": "node",
      "args": ["worker/mcp-server.js"],
      "env": {
        "WORKER_API": "https://objectle-worker-demo.marvelus.workers.dev/api"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

**Strategy:**
1. Read initial view (silhouette)
2. Rotate to see multiple angles
3. Make informed first guess
4. Use facet feedback (category/material/scale)
5. Unlock zoom, refine with detail
6. Iterate until solved

See DEMO.md for full playthrough example.

## Architecture

- **Frontend**: React + React Three Fiber + Vite
- **Backend**: Cloudflare Worker + D1
- **Deployment**: Cloudflare Pages + Workers
- **MCP Server**: Node.js stdio server

**Stack:**
- Three.js for 3D rendering
- ACES tone mapping, studio lighting
- Contact shadows, Lightformers/Environment
- Cool off-white theme (light mode only)
- Zustand state management

## Local Development

```bash
# Install
npm install

# Setup D1 database
wrangler d1 create objectle-db
wrangler d1 execute objectle-db --local --file=./schema.sql

# Start Worker
npm run worker:dev

# Start frontend
npm run dev
```

## Deployment

**Worker:**
```bash
npm run worker:deploy
```

**Pages (via GitHub Actions):**
Push to main branch. Workflow auto-deploys.

## Anti-Cheat

- Answer only on Worker, never sent to client
- Opaque object keys (daily/obj_abc123, not bicycle.glb)
- GLTF metadata stripped
- Rate limiting
- Synonym validation

## Adding Objects

```sql
INSERT INTO daily_challenges (date, object_key, object_name, category, material, scale)
VALUES ('2026-09-09', 'daily/obj_lamp_001', 'lamp', 'furniture', 'metal', 'medium');

INSERT INTO synonyms (canonical, synonym) VALUES ('lamp', 'light');
```

Path to 100: source/commission models, optimize (<10k tris), upload to R2, batch insert daily_challenges, maintain synonym coverage.

## Tech Highlights

- WebMCP protocol for agent interaction
- Heardle-style gating (zoom unlocks progressively)
- Worldle-style facet grid for share cards
- Silhouette-to-color reveal progression
- Light studio with Lightformers (cool/off-white)
- Procedural geometry MVP (scales to GLTF/R2)
